address: 347 Fuhua North Road, Wuhou, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: The young chef from Chaoshan region opened this cosy joint after working in some upmarket eateries. The room is decorated with wooden moulds for making stuffed dumplings, alongside coffee table books on Chaoshan cooking. The menu spins with the season, but staples such as marinated goose and the catch of the day like steamed silver whiting with chicken broth, are always on the menu. Make sure you book and pre-order your food....
